sentences.text: The Royal Commission into the Robodebt Scheme was asked to investigate how the scheme was created and run, responses to concerns, debt collection and its human and economic effects.
sentences.support: how risks and concerns in relation to it were dealt with and how complaints and challenges were managed by the Government

sentences.text: It examined income averaging, automated decisions, debt recovery and the roles of legal advisers and oversight agencies.
sentences.support: What follows is some description and discussion of automated decision making and data matching

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that income averaging produced inaccurate debts using a method the social security legislation did not permit.
sentences.support: not only were the resulting debts inaccurate, but the method of determining entitlement was not one which the Social Security Act permitted

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the scheme caused trauma and was a costly failure of public administration.
sentences.support: In essence, people were traumatised on the off-chance they might owe money. It was a costly failure of public administration, in both human and economic terms.

sentences.text: The Commission made 57 recommendations, including changes to recipient support, budget safeguards, automated decisions, debt recovery and public service accountability.
sentences.support: The following is a list of 57 recommendations of this Commission.

findings.quote: It was a costly failure of public administration, in both human and economic terms.
The Scheme was approved by Cabinet and proceeded without the legislative change to support averaging which DSS had said was needed.
The Ombudsman was deliberately misled, thus providing further opportunity for the Government to resist scrutiny by using his report as a shield.

notes: The report explicitly lists 57 recommendations on PDF page 19; meta.json records 56 recommendations on the OPAX page. The overview occupies PDF pages 29–35, followed by a blank verso. Citations use PDF page numbers.
